acceptance: A replay of the wave 185 signal log and abnormal events wakes the watch before 10:00Z.
A replay of wave 184 and earlier waves does not wake it on normal volume.
The wake signal names the trigger, the lanes and the evidence paths.
wave-operations.md names the zero-ship first look.
fix: Design review first. Add a stall trigger to evolve wave watch: it emits one signal when the wave is older than a bound with live lanes and no ship, or when one abnormal event kind passes a rate in a window across lanes. The signal is a lossless channel event that the console listener takes like ORCHESTRATOR_BLOCKER_ROUTED. Bounds live in policy. Start with stage shadow. Add the zero-ship first look to docs/operations/wave-operations.md: read lane stall signals and abnormal events before you wait.
summary: Wave 185 ran 5.7 hours with 8 live lanes and 0 of 9 cycles shipped. The console watches woke only on failure codes. LOOP_ORCH_LANE_STALLED fired 9 times and abnormal events verify-single-flight-unavailable fired 75 times, and nothing woke on them. The console read zero ships at about 10:00Z and waited until 13:50Z.
title: The wave watch and the console wake on a stall: no ship against wave age, and a repeated abnormal event kind
